name: ProjectMind for OpenAI Codex (CLI / IDE / Desktop)
description: Project intelligence, MCP stdio server integration, skills, and AGENTS.md instructions for OpenAI Codex.

capabilities.restartInstructions: Restart your Codex CLI session or select Restart in the Codex IDE/Desktop MCP servers menu.
documentedLimitations: Codex cloud/managed orchestration restricts local command hooks via allow_managed_hooks_only; automatic invocation uses MCP initialize instructions + AGENTS.md + skill.

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install codex` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update codex` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall codex` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
